audienceMoment: A homeowner has no hot water, a leak, an aging heater, or a planned replacement but may not know the equipment type, feasible alternatives, scope drivers or what to send first.
pagePromise: Help the visitor identify the current setup, compare viable replacement paths, understand the variables that change scope, and prepare a real phone or SMS request without relying on reputation claims.
reasonToExist: Folsom provides a verified local minor-permit/eTRAKiT starting point, while the page turns replacement uncertainty into a bounded equipment and request decision.
competitiveApproach: Compete through decision transparency, concrete preparation and honest claim boundaries rather than reviews, history, prices or unsupported trust language.
primaryConversion: Phone call or prepared SMS request.
compositionThesis: An asymmetric editorial planner with six necessary blocks; omit generic process, emergency, FAQ and repeated final-CTA recipes.
successCondition: The visitor can name or flag uncertainty about the current heater, understand the three replacement paths, identify scope inputs and start the verified request flow.
